Title: Vast Wealth and multiple Leather Jackets

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
Titus Camille has a Leather Jacket and Vast Wealth. He uses the Vast
Wealth's ability to take a +1 stealth action to equip with the first
piece of equipment he finds in the my library. Nobody blocks this
action. The first piece of equipment I find is a Leather Jacket.
Leather Jacket's card text states that a minion can only have one
Leather Jacket.
I assume that the second Jacket burns immediately.
Some questions however arise:
Does Titus Camille untap at the end of my turn? I would say yes, as the
action to equip the jacket was successful (i.e. nobody blocked the
action, the action didn't fizzle due to lack of blood, etc.)
Could Titus Camille Freak Drive (at inferior fortitude) after this
action?
